items.note: Compares structural diversity and quality of 6,875 essays across human-only, AI-only, and three Human+AI prompt strategies; per the search notes the Human+AI essays are LLM rewrites of existing AIDE corpus essays, so no person received AI help (borderline model_only).

Uses about 7,500 master's admissions applications (2020-2025) and the arrival of ChatGPT to estimate effects of AI availability on essay writing quality and admission; the outcome is writing quality, not creativity or diversity, and the separate admissions-officer experiment is about perception of AI writing.

Two preregistered experiments (3,750 participants in total, split not stated) compare prompting with models of different capability and automated prompt rewriting, including an open-ended creative text-to-image task scored on performance; the comparison is AI configuration versus AI configuration.

Analyzes 957 student debates with an AI adversary and compares voice and text modality on repetition and breadth of ideas; assignment of modality is not stated and may be observational, and a debate is a borderline creative task.

System paper (HALO) with an expert study of 10 medicinal chemists reporting higher-quality and more diverse candidate molecules with the system; comparison condition not described in the abstract, and N is below 50.

Journal abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, Europe PMC); the linked Mendeley dataset (10.17632/ykv6hwy6ky.1) describes 76 undergraduates in a poster design task split by stratified quasi-random assignment into a Doubao group (39) and a no-device control (37), with blind ratings of effectiveness, correctness, and novelty.

224 students randomly assigned to 97 online triads (human-only, supportive-AI teammate, contrarian-AI teammate) for an individual-group-individual creative movie-plot task; creative performance is reported, and the AI is an undisclosed teammate rather than an assistant (randomization may be at triad level).

Two-group quasi-experiment in a Chinese vocational college comparing project-based learning in an AI-enabled immersive virtual environment with traditional PBL on design creativity; whether the intelligent agents are generative AI is unclear and the treatment bundles VR with AI.

Preregistered RCT in a creative writing task varying incentives (originality versus quality); the search notes report a 2x2 design that also randomizes AI assistant versus writing alone with N=200 on Prolific, which the abstract does not state; outcome is collective diversity of texts.

2,234 participants randomly assigned to human-human or human-AI-agent teams producing 11,024 ads, rated by independent raters and tested in a field experiment on X; human-AI outputs were higher text quality and more homogeneous (latest version v3, 2026).
